name: cmdb_customview_link
label: Custom View Associated Table in CMDB
description: The custom view in the CMDB is associated with the table for use in configuration management-related queries and report scenarios.

fields.name: customview_id
fields.description: View ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: from_uuid
fields.description: The source view UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: to_uuid
fields.description: The target view UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_type
fields.description: Source type. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the customview_id, UUID fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_fromcustomviewci_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the to_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_to_attr_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the from_type field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_view_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the from_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
